stories.title: Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a strict schema for tool scope including allowed tool names, permitted parameter shapes, and scope boundaries per conversation context. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic tool_models and allowlist structure.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Core Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to validate each tool call against the defined scope contract, including allowlist membership, parameter validation, and context-based restrictions before execution.

stories.title: Integration with Tool Router Dispatch Flow
stories.description: Integrate scope enforcement into the existing tool_router dispatch pipeline to intercept all tool calls prior to execution, ensuring no bypass paths exist.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create test coverage for valid and invalid tool calls, including out-of-scope tools, malformed inputs, and boundary cases. Ensure enforcement works across all registered tools.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Response Handling and Observability
stories.description: Implement standardized error/response handling for rejected tool calls including structured error codes, safe user-facing messaging, and debug logging for auditability of scope violations.
